content: आकुञ्चनम् .²1 Bending, contraction, compression; <ls>Ku. 78</ls> <ab>&c.</ab> also उत्क्षेपणं तथावक्षेपणमाकुञ्चनं तथा <ls>Bhāṣā P.</ls> .²2 Contraction regarded as one of the 5 {%karmans%} <ab>q. v.</ab> .²3 Collecting, heaping. .²4 Curving. .²5 Contortion. .²6 A kind of army movement; आकुञ्चनं तथा यानं प्रयाणमपयानकम् <ls>Śukra. 4. 1100</ls>.
